patch_description:
The current program regressed by removing the initial RY parity layer that was present in the first prior program (which scored 0.58). The initial parity-based RY layer with parameters alternating between ry_0 (even wires) and ry_1 (odd wires) is critical for robust separation of hard samples and better generalization.

Additionally, insert a mid-circuit shared RZ layer (rz_mid applied to all 8 qubits) after the two-qubit interaction block. This adds expressivity to the circuit's middle section without introducing new distinct parameters - the rz_mid parameter is reused across all qubits.

This restores the proven structure from the first prior program while adding one new distinct parameter (rz_mid), keeping us well within the n_distinct≤12 sweet spot. Expected improvements:
- Worst_group_margin_mean: 0.27 → ~0.35+ (restore robustness)
- Validation_margin_mean: 0.50 → ~0.57-0.60 (restore separation)
- Generalization_gap_mean: 0.14 → ~0.04-0.11 (better held-out performance)
- Combined score: 0.54 → ~0.58+
